cohort: Very low birth weight infants (VLBWI) admitted to a NICU between January 2015 and January 2017 were included.
finding: Elevated NTproBNP levels at 14 days of life effectively predict the development of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) in very low birth weight infants, independent of hemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (HsPDA).
followup_time: 49 days after birth for NTproBNP measurements
